note: Critical control-plane skill lock (T012/T013, specs/005-elt-control-plane-convergence). Flat, drift-detectable ledger for the mandatory-parity skill set: elt + its aliases (elt-code, elt-loop) and project-bootstrap. sourceKind tells the checker where the canonical file lives: 'repo' = tracked in this repo (source path is repo-relative), 'home' = canonical lives in ~/.claude/skills/* (source path is home-relative; the claude target is the source itself). The checker (tools/doctor-core.js:checkAgentSkillsLock) always recomputes sha256 live from the source at check time — the sha256 field here is a record of the last known-good value, not the comparison ground truth, so editing a SKILL.md doesn't require a lock.json edit to stay green. Separate from config/agent-skill-sources.json (the broader review-workflow manifest for a different, non-critical skill set).
